question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:
 
The cleric wore a silk **amice** over his alb during the liturgy.

options.text: The altar server retrieved the amice from the vestry.
The novelist described her protagonist's scarf as an amice.
The bishop adjusted the amice before the blessing.
The amice was embroidered with gold thread.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'The novelist described her protagonist's scarf as an amice.'**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The word **"amice"** refers to a white liturgical vestment worn around the neck and shoulders by clergy. (धार्मिक वस्त्र) 
• **Example:** The priest carefully placed the amice over his shoulders before the ceremony began. 
• A **homonym** is a word that has the same spelling or pronunciation but a different meaning. 
• In **Option 2**, "amice" is used to refer to a **scarf or garment**, showing a different contextual meaning from the religious vestment. (दुपट्टा / स्कार्फ जैसा वस्त्र) 
• **Example:** The designer called the decorative scarf an amice in her fashion collection. 
Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 2.**
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
• **Option 1:** Refers to the same religious vestment. (धार्मिक वस्त्र) 
• **Example:** The amice was kept safely in the vestry. 
• **Option 3:** Again refers to the same clerical garment. (धार्मिक वस्त्र) 
• **Example:** The bishop adjusted his amice before starting the prayer. 
• **Option 4:** Describes the same liturgical vestment. (धार्मिक वस्त्र) 
• **Example:** The amice was beautifully embroidered for the special service. 
40:Ta32,

The correct answer is 'Option 1'<
